messages:
lina: Quick heads-up — we have a visiting partner (Dana, Acme Partners) arriving Wed 11:15am. Can we reserve the window hot-desk for them? She'll only be here 2-3 hours and would prefer a quiet spot.

devon: Window hot-desk sounds good. Which floor?

dina: (typing) whoops typo, ignore — sorry!

maria: 7th floor, near the conference nook — I can clear the chair and put a 'reserved until 2pm' sticky.

lina: Thanks Maria. Also, FYI: three packages showed up this AM addressed to "Acme Partnership — Dana". Front desk says they need a signature. Could those be routed to the hot-desk when she checks in?

frontdesk-bot: Automated: Packages received for Dana (3 items). Tracking: 1) UPS 1Z999AA10123456784 2) DHL JD0001234567890 3) Internal envelope. Held at front desk. ID required at pick-up.

devon: Tagging @samir for access — Samir, can you temporarily add Dana to guest Wi‑Fi and issue a QR badge? Our QR badge printer is low on labels otherwise we do a digital badge.

samir: Yup, I can do guest wifi + digital badge. I'll create a one-time QR that expires at 3pm.

maria: Front desk asked if we want to put packages in a locker or keep them behind the desk. Lockers are better if Dana might step out. Locker 12 is free. Code I set is 8312 (I'll change after).

lina: Perfect — locker + digital badge. Maria — can you paste the locker code in the check-in note for front desk (not in this channel)?

maria: Done, note added to the front desk ticket.

devon: Small ask — could someone move the potted ficus (next to the window desk) back to the corner? It blocks the monitor a bit.

maria: On it.

frontdesk-bot: Reminder: Visitor Dana (Acme) scheduled 1769141700 — check-in window 11:15–14:15. Packages already logged under visitor record.

lina: Awesome, thanks everyone. If anything changes I'll update here. :thumbsup:

samir: QR badge sent to Dana's email (dana@acmepartners.com). I also gave temporary printer access for a single badge if you prefer physical.

devon: Nice. Also — quick poll: should we add a small guest welcome sign at that desk? yes/no?

maria: yes — 1-line welcome card + wifi/printing quicknotes. I'll print a template.

lina: Vote tally: yes 2, no 0, undecided 2. Going with yes. Thanks team! :party:
